title: Participation in Degenerative Scoliosis
summary: The study retrospectively analyzes all patients who developed degenerative scoliosis in adulthood and were treated as inpatients at the study center. The aim is to analyze the relationships between spinal changes, the chosen treatment, the resulting complications, and the associated participation problems.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of X-ray and MRI images as well as the clinical courses of patients with degenerative scoliosis who were treated as inpatients at the study center in the years 2014-2024. Current participation problems are assessed using an electronic ICF-based questionnaire.
Assessment of participation impairment in patients with degenerative scoliosis who have not yet undergone surgery or conservative treatment at the study center.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion Criteria
- All patients with degenerative scoliosis who have been treated as inpatients at the study center within the last 10 years. This equates to approximately 300 contactable patients (the exact number can only be determined after filtering the cases based on the medical records).

- Medical records and stored X-ray and MRI diagnostics will be evaluated for these patients. This can be done even without the patients' consent.

- In addition, the patients will be contacted by telephone and/or in writing (letter/email) to obtain current data on participation and quality of life (SF-36). The patients will be informed about the study and must give their consent.

- If the patients have already died or do not wish to provide information, this will be recorded and included in the analysis.

The control group (branch 2) consists of patients with degenerative scoliosis who present themselves for consultation at the spine clinic of the study center and who wish to participate in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
• No (X-ray/MRI image analysis)
• Lack of consent (assessment of participation impairment)
